Spent some time at @neharoongtafinejewellery and honestly, there’s something for every kind of occasion — from pieces you can wear with your festive looks to statement jewellery for weddings and those this deserves its own moment pieces. 💎

What I especially loved? The designs feel timeless but not predictable, so you can actually see yourself wearing them beyond just one occasion.

If you’re jewellery shopping for the festive and wedding season, save this one. 🤍 

#NehaRoongtaFineJewellery #MumbaiJewellery #RealJewellery #FineJewellery #festivefashionwithmallika

This festive season, The Polkaa Dots brings fashion, craft, culture & food under one roof.

Discover homegrown and debut designers from across India, many making their Mumbai debut, plus a first-time showcase from Sri Lanka 🇱🇰✨

From artisanal finds to curated craft, culture and food brands, every section is thoughtfully selected.

It’s your one-stop festive destination for festive wear, accessories, handcrafted pieces and treats. ✨

📍 Soraia Bombay, Mumbai
📅 18th August 2026
